privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.draft: Draft for the prototype. The church’s data protection adviser checks and completes this text, including the parts in brackets, before the app is used.
privacyNotice.intro: The app of the Coptic Orthodox Church KHMK Köln helps servants organise meetings, attendance, lessons and homework, and shows parents their children’s homework. This notice explains which personal data the app stores, why, who can see it, and what rights you have.

responsible.title: Who is responsible
responsible.text: Coptic Orthodox Church KHMK Köln, [address of the church office]. Questions about data protection: [email address of the church office or the data protection adviser].

data.title: What the app stores

items.accounts: Accounts: name, email address, password (only in a form that can’t be read back), language, roles, and when you accepted this notice.
items.members: Members: first and last name, a preferred name, and the services and classes they belong to, from when to when.
items.attendance: Attendance: who was marked present at which meeting, and by whom. The app records presence only, never absence.
items.homework: Homework: which homework a parent reported as done for which child, and when.
items.links: Parent access: which parent accounts may see which children.
items.registration: When you register: what you write about your children or your service, until the church office has decided on your account.

data.text: The app stores nothing else: no photos, no addresses, no birthdays, no grades.

why.title: Why
why.text: To run the church’s services: to know who belongs to which group, to prepare meetings, and to look after the children entrusted to us. Because the data shows that people belong to our church, we treat all of it as sensitive: it stays within the church, and only the people who need it can see it.

who.title: Who can see it

items.servants: Servants see the people and attendance of the groups they serve in.
items.leaders: Service leaders see their whole service.
items.admins: Administrators in the church office manage accounts, roles and parent access.
items.parents: Parents see only their own children’s published homework: never attendance, notes or other families.

who.text: The app is hosted by [hosting provider in the EU] under a data processing agreement. No data is sold or passed on.

howLong.title: How long it is kept

items.accounts: Accounts: until you or the church office delete them.
items.declined: Registrations that are declined: deleted at once.
items.members: Members who leave: [period decided by the church], then deleted.

howLong.text: When data is deleted, the numbers of past meetings stay right, but nobody can tell who was there.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text:
You can ask for a copy of your data, have it corrected or deleted, restrict its use or object to it. You can also complain to a data protection authority; in North Rhine-Westphalia that is the Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit (LDI NRW).

In the app, open your account and go to “Your data” to download a copy or to ask for your account to be deleted. Or ask the church office. We answer within one month.
